title: Read One Chapter
body: Read one full chapter of the Gospel of John today, slowly, as if reading it for the first time.

title: Memorize a Verse
body: Choose today's verse and try to recite it from memory three times before bed.

title: Pray Without a List
body: Spend five minutes in prayer without asking for anything — only gratitude and listening.

title: Fast From Complaint
body: For the next 24 hours, try to replace every complaint with a specific thank-you to God.

title: Trace a Promise
body: Search the Psalms for one promise of God and write it somewhere you'll see it all week.

title: Read a Parable
body: Read the Parable of the Prodigal Son (Luke 15:11-32) and ask which character you relate to most today.

title: Silence Before Sound
body: Before checking your phone tomorrow morning, spend two minutes in silence with God.

title: Bless Someone Specifically
body: Send a message to someone today naming one specific thing you appreciate about them.

title: Read the Beatitudes
body: Read Matthew 5:1-12 slowly and sit with the one that challenges you most.

title: Give Something Away
body: Give away something you own to someone who needs it more than you do.
